reading_issues: Height-axis chart with an axis break: blue 'PIT 115' line and a zig-zag below it mean the pit bottom is 115 cm above ground (HS 235, 120 cm dug); heights are above ground as the axis labels show, calibrated on the 10 cm gridlines (10.52 px/cm) and the 235 cm / 115 cm lines. Layout is the mirror of the usual one: Grain Form column and height axis on the left, bars grow rightward, hardness ticks F/4f/1f/P/K left to right (evenly spaced). Only one glyph is in the Grain Form table (open circle on the 2 cm top row); all other table rows are blank, so grain is null except the two thin 1 cm layers whose grain/size come from the test labels (PP 4.0 mm at 192-193 cm; SH 4.0-8.0 mm 'Jan 3rd' at 159-160 cm). The ECTP label carries no tap count (taps null). Notes field blank; blowing snow '--' (null). Top open-circle glyph read as MFcr (P-hard 2 cm surface layer) by the TRANSCRIBE rule; plain MF is the alternative. Two tapered hardness bars: layer means recorded, end values in comments. No temperature profile.
